title: AIify | Custom AI Swarms That Run Your Business
description: AIify builds custom co-managed AI swarms for companies. We build them, you own them, and we use them with you every week. The first company account is $10,000 per month, and each additional account is $4,000 per month.

hero.heading: Custom AI swarms that run your business.
hero.body: We build them. You own them. We use them together. Use a swarm of genius AI agents and do more in a day than most get done in a month.

intro.label: Why now
intro.heading: “We know AI could do more for us. We just don't have time to set it up.”
intro.lead: Most companies already pay for a few AI tools. They sit half-used because the people who would get the most out of them have the least spare time. And by the time someone learns one, a better one has shipped.
intro.question: So who on your team is supposed to set this up and keep it current, on top of running the company?

model.heading: What you get
model.body: Plenty of companies pay for AI software that nobody ends up using. The difference here is that our team works in it with you. We set the swarm up, build with you every week, and keep it running. You also get a monthly group coaching call and a members area.
model.label: How it works

steps.title: We learn your goals.
steps.body: We start with your executives and their assistants: how the business runs today, and what you want taken off their plates.

steps.title: We set the swarm up.
steps.body: We build custom AI agents around the way your business already works, so your team isn't learning a whole new way of operating on day one.

steps.title: We build with you every week.
steps.body: Each week we sit down with you, add new work to the swarm, and fix whatever needs fixing.

steps.title: We aim the agents at your goals.
steps.body: When priorities shift, we point the agents at what matters now so they keep working on the right things.

steps.title: We keep you current on AI.
steps.body: AI changes fast. We update your swarm as it does, and the monthly group coaching call and members area help you keep up too.

model.platform: Right now we co-manage in Grok Bot. The way we work doesn't depend on any one platform, so you aren't tied to one.

evidence.heading: Who we work with, and what you keep
evidence.body: We work with the people who run the company and the people closest to them. A small group is what keeps the swarm in daily use.

There's no fixed headcount. We serve executives and their immediate assistants.

evidence.closing: If you're the one signing off, here's what you're approving: a swarm your company owns, and a team that keeps working on it with you every week.

economics.label: Pricing
economics.heading: What it costs as you bring more leaders in.
economics.body: Your first company account is $10,000 a month. Each account after that is $4,000 a month. An account covers one executive plus their chief of staff or executive assistant, so the person who already keeps their week on track works with the swarm alongside them. When you want more of your leadership involved, you add another account at the lower rate.

ownership.label: What you own
ownership.heading: What we build for you belongs to you.

points.title: You own the swarms.
points.body: The agents, how they're set up, and the playbooks written around your business are yours. AIify keeps its own methods.

points.title: You own the data.
points.body: Your data belongs to your company, and it stays that way.

points.title: You own the work.
points.body: Whatever the swarm produces is yours to keep and use however you like.

questions.a: Software is the smallest part of it. Most of what you're paying for is the work we do with you: setting the swarm up, building with you every week, aiming the agents at your goals, and keeping it current as AI changes.

questions.q: Should we build this team ourselves?
questions.a: You can. It means recruiting AI people, hiring someone to manage them, covering payroll and turnover, and keeping up with AI on your own. Working with us gets you the swarm and weekly hands-on help without adding that headcount.

One account is an executive and their immediate assistant, such as a chief of staff or executive assistant. We only serve executives and their assistants. If more of your leadership team wants in, add another account.

quote.heading: Get started.
quote.body: Tell us what your business does and what you'd want off your executives' plates. Your first company account is $10,000 a month, and each one you add after that is $4,000 a month. Someone on our team will read your message and write back.
quote.reply: A real person replies. You won't be dropped into an automated sequence.
